_comment: Packages whose licence ships as a LICENSE file inside the package (nuget-license reports type File, which it cannot map). Verified by reading the file; keep the version pinned so a licence change on a bump is re-checked.

Microsoft.Data.SqlClient's native SNI runtime (E2.2). LICENSE.txt in the package is the MICROSOFT SOFTWARE LICENSE TERMS for the SNI library, the same proprietary library terms nuget-license maps to MS-.NET-Library elsewhere; verified by reading the file.

MSAL native interop pulled in by Microsoft.Data.SqlClient (E2.2). LICENSE in the package is the MICROSOFT SOFTWARE LICENSE TERMS (proprietary library terms, MS-.NET-Library); verified by reading the file.
